integrity: The all-degree result is proved analytically by an exact hyperbolic reparameterization and a monotonicity argument. Finite replay computations are corroborative only and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the translation-invariant 4-height-periodic subfamily \(u=1,\ w=v\) of the alternating-magnetism model. It does not classify the full three-variable 4-periodic system and makes no claim about extremality, reconstruction, stability, or thermodynamic dominance.
title: Sharp all-degree threshold for a 4-periodic alternating-magnetism SOS branch
